run_dingtalk_bot: run the DingTalk bot by starting DingTalkApp with client credentials for streaming messages
send_text_dingtalk: send a text message to a DingTalk user or group chat via DingTalkApp.send_text
handle_dingtalk_message: handle an incoming DingTalk message through DingTalkApp.on_message with sender and conversation details
get_dingtalk_token: get a DingTalk OAuth access token using DingTalkApp._get_access_token with client id and secret
process_dingtalk_callback: process a DingTalk chatbot callback message via _DingTalkHandler.process with text extraction and sender info
